decisions.rationale: The human accepted the two-store outcome and registration/selection sequence; existing contracts already lock tenancy, managed SKU and reviewed opening balance.

decisions.choice: An Inventory account can own multiple stock pools. Each new store receives a separate server-created pool by default. The merchant may explicitly join an existing pool only after server verification that the pool belongs to the same account. Different customers stay isolated. Browser-provided account or pool identifiers do not grant authority. Joining never silently merges or migrates a populated pool. This is logical behavior, not a physical database topology change.
